analogs.class: GABA benzodiazepine site receptor inverse agonist

analogy.rationale: GABA receptor modulators act on GABA-A/GABA-B receptors that are largely neuronal and barely expressed in these cell lines, so transcriptional responses should be weak; the most similar classes are other GABA-receptor-directed drugs, with benzodiazepine-site ligands and GABA uptake inhibitors sharing the same pathway.
